purpose: One-time migration of established storefront categories into additive Shopify tags, preserving existing product types and all current provider tags.

source.visibleFilter: hidden IS NULL OR hidden = false

mutationPolicy.rollback: Remove only the exact tags added by this manifest if they were absent immediately before application; never replace tag lists from a snapshot.

reviewNotes: Categories preserve the current storefront merchandising exactly. A category may differ from the product type or ordinary tags; those are not overwritten.
This manifest does not publish products, change availability, rename products, infer category from a title, or alter vendor/provider mappings.
Nonhidden legacy records absent from current Shopify remain excluded; do not substitute similarly named replacement products.
Shopify ACTIVE status is only a baseline check; runtime Storefront publication remains the final customer-facing visibility authority.
